subject: gk
question: e-NAM is primarily aimed at which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National digital market**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **e-NAM** stands for **National Agriculture Market**, which is a pan-India electronic trading portal to connect existing Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs) to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
 
• The primary objective of e-NAM is to establish a **National digital market** for agricultural produce, enabling farmers to sell their produce across the nation and not be restricted to local markets.
 
• e-NAM integrates markets through a virtual platform, reducing intermediation costs, ensuring better price discovery, and improving market transparency.
 
• Launched by the Government of India on **14th April 2016**, it aims to provide remunerative prices to farmers by improving their bargaining power.
 
• As of **October 2023**, over **1000 APMC mandis** from various states and union territories have been integrated with the e-NAM platform.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Functions and Features of e-NAM:**

 
 
• It facilitates **online trading** of agricultural commodities and integrates APMC markets across the country.
 
• Provides a single window service for all APMC-related information and services, including commodity arrivals, quality assessment, and real-time price discovery.
 
• Farmers can directly connect with buyers, avoiding intermediaries, and ensuring better returns.
 
• It supports various languages and is accessible through mobile and desktop platforms, making it user-friendly for farmers.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of e-NAM:**
 
 
• Enhances **price discovery** through a transparent auction mechanism based on the quality of produce.
 
• Reduces transaction costs and eliminates the need for physical presence at the market by allowing e-bidding.
 
• Promotes **uniformity** in agricultural marketing by streamlining processes and removing information asymmetry between buyers and sellers.
 
• Encourages interstate trade of agricultural produce, leading to better market integration at the national level.
 
 
 
• **Other Agricultural Initiatives by the Indian Government:**
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY):** Launched in 2016, it provides a comprehensive risk cover for crops, ensuring financial support to farmers in case of crop failure.
 
• **Soil Health Card Scheme:** Introduced in 2015, this scheme aims to provide farmers with information on soil health and recommendations for nutrient management.
 
• **Kisan Credit Card (KCC):** It provides short-term credit to farmers for agricultural and allied activities at subsidized rates.
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY):** Launched to improve irrigation efficiency and ensure water accessibility for every farm in India.
 
 
 
• **Important Reports:**
 
 
• According to the **Economic Survey 2020-21**, the implementation of e-NAM has significantly improved market access for farmers and reduced wastage of produce.
 
• The **World Bank Report** on agriculture highlights the role of digital platforms like e-NAM in reducing barriers to market access for small and marginal farmers.
